search_audit.query: Academia Sinica Xiaoxuetang 飯 字形演變; Wikimedia Commons 飯 bronze inscription character glyph; 飯 bronze script glyph image Wiktionary
search_audit.outcome: Search returned a bronze-style 飯 SVG on Wiktionary and the Xiaoxuetang database home. Opened the home page; attempted to open both file description pages, but both returned cache-miss failures. A guessed Xiaoxuetang character route was inaccessible.

search_audit.query: site:commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File 飯 bronze.svg; "飯-bronze.svg" "Public domain"; site:xiaoxue.iis.sinica.edu.tw "飯" "CC0"
search_audit.outcome: Search did not return a Commons page for 飯-bronze.svg. It returned unrelated bronze-script file pages, which were not used as evidence for the 飯 candidate.

search_audit.query: Opened direct Commons 飯-bronze.svg file page and Special:Redirect/file URL
search_audit.outcome: Both attempts failed: the file page returned a cache miss and the redirect URL was inaccessible.

gaps: The bronze-style SVG is a candidate modern drawing, not an artifact photograph. Because its description page could not be opened and a Commons file page was not found, its source image, authorship details, and reuse license were not verified to the required standard.
No character-specific Xiaoxuetang record, exact rendered-glyph URL, or official CC0 notice was inspected. No Xiaoxuetang image is proposed.

No historical glyph image is selected: identity and reuse provenance remain unverified. Dossier evidence reports a bronze 飯 form and a Small Seal form, but no candidate image from those sources was visually inspected here.

limitations.text: Search found a bronze-style SVG candidate, but its description page failed to open, and the direct Commons page was inaccessible. With reuse provenance unverified, no image is proposed.
Xiaoxuetang’s database home was inspected, but no record-specific glyph image or rights notice was retrieved; no image from that database is proposed.
